title: Psycho Killer
summary: A cover-driven music identity shaped as an album-first art direction system.
history: Psycho Killer reframes music packaging as a restrained portrait language built for album, motion teaser, and streaming surfaces.
The direction keeps a cinematic stillness while staying legible across digital releases and campaign crops.

title: Music Senses
summary: An atmospheric music visual built around silence, distance, and restrained ambient mood.
history: Music Senses frames sound as landscape, using minimal light and negative space to imply a slow cinematic build.
The artwork is structured for cover usage, streaming thumbnails, and quiet editorial music rollouts.

title: Vitra Campaign
summary: A tactile campaign system centered on product texture, contrast, and editorial framing.
history: Vitra Campaign explores how product photography can feel structural, warm, and editorial without losing utility.
The image system is tuned for campaign cards, identity rollouts, and launch storytelling.

title: 4tential
summary: A blurred performance portrait built as a music-facing visual identity with luminous color wash.
history: 4tential uses diffusion, glow, and silhouette to create a performance image that feels emotional and immediate.
The system is designed for album covers, teaser stills, and motion-led music promotion.

title: Kanebo Beauty
summary: A beauty visual direction designed around reflective skin, warmth, and premium restraint.
history: Kanebo Beauty studies how a beauty brand can balance intimacy, luxury, and controlled softness.
The result is structured for campaign hero cuts, digital lookbooks, and editorial placements.

title: Clear Water
summary: A generated visual experiment around water, light bloom, and translucent abstraction.
history: Clear Water is an AI-first poster series that investigates fluid highlights, glare, and minimal material cues.
The output is intended for poster walls, still frames, and generative visual campaigns.

title: Berserk VFX
summary: A motion-driven character visual designed for title, trailer, and key art extension.
history: Berserk VFX explores an intense motion language through metallic form, glow, and high-contrast portrait staging.
The system is conceived for moving key art, short teasers, and motion showcase frames.

title: YSL, 2026FW
summary: A monochrome fashion campaign direction built for seasonal identity and launch staging.
history: YSL, 2026FW uses silhouette, sparkle, and black-and-white contrast to define a campaign-led identity mood.
The visual system supports editorial rollout, hero images, and launch communication.

title: Visual Concept
summary: A generative visual concept series mixing fashion portraiture with surreal poster composition.
history: Visual Concept treats AI imagery as a poster wall language rather than a single hero visual.
The composition system is designed for masonic repetition, editorial crops, and experimental layouts.
